image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) curled in a C-shape on a rough, grey stone surface. The amphibian displays characteristic glossy black skin with vivid, irregular yellow patches and spots. Its head is visible on the right, showing a broad shape and small dark eye. The limbs are tucked close to the body due to the curled posture, but forelimbs are partially visible. The tail curves around the body, ending near the head.
